text:
cody (AE): Heads up—POC kickoff with Zephyrus (fintech). Requirements: SSO/SAML, SCIM bulk + PATCH, RBAC mapping, delegated domain ownership, and air-gapped on-prem connector for vaults. Need tech + pricing input.

josh (SE): Quick clarifying q's: SCIM throughput expected? SP vs IdP init preference? Do they need PATCH and deltas vs full imports?

cody (AE): Expect ~20k users initially, ~200 updates/min peak during payroll. SP-initiated preferred; they can do IdP flows for a few partners. PATCH + deltas required.

natasha (Solutions): For 20k with 200/min bursts, recommend Dedicated capacity for provisioning windows. Hosted might hit SCIM rate tiers under bursts—will include pricing delta for higher request volume.

leila (Security): They want KMS/HSM integration, customer-managed TLS certs, mTLS for the on-prem connector, and logs retained in their VPC for audit. We should confirm support for key rotation and export controls.

sam (Presales): Domain verification: they can't add TXT records in some tenants and asked about delegated DNS verification. We support TXT, file-based proof, and select OAuth-based delegation. For org-wide delegation we can lock domain claims and enable tenant scoping.

josh (SE): RBAC mapping: we map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles and support attribute-based role rules. Nested groups flatten for membership; if they need hierarchical RBAC enforced, app-level checks are needed.

leila (Security): SCIM PII must be encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest. Audit logs must include actor, timestamp, and diffs. We can forward events to their SIEM via syslog or HTTPS forwarder.

cody (AE): KMS question: can we integrate with their cloud KMS while using Hosted or do they need Private?

natasha (Solutions): Hosted can integrate with customer-managed KMS if keys are reachable from our region. For true air-gapped HSM (keys never leave their network) Private deployment is required.

sam (Presales): Sharing a SCIM PATCH sample for testing against staging.

sam (Presales): ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://staging-api.redwood.dev/scim/v2/Users/{id} -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails[type eq \"work\"].value","value":"jane.new@zephyrus.com"}]}'
```

josh (SE): Also note our rate-limit headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch). Recommend exponential backoff + jitter on 429s.

leila (Security): Uploaded the security questionnaire draft and risk matrix. compliance-bot: security questionnaire (Zephyrus) uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/compliance/zephyrus-qna (doc id 9f3c).

compliance-bot: :white_check_mark: Questionnaire uploaded. Next step: legal to review redacted SOC2 and sign DPA addendum.

cody (AE): Action items: natasha to price Dedicated vs Hosted with burst buffer; leila to finalize KMS/HSM notes + audit retention; josh to prepare POC checklist and sample SCIM export. I'll book a 30m technical call with Zephyrus. :thumbsup:

natasha (Solutions): Will send pricing scenarios by EOD, including 1yr reserved estimate.

josh (SE): I'll post the POC checklist and test payloads shortly.

leila (Security): I'll attach the KMS/HSM matrix and confirm mTLS + key wrapping details.

cody (AE): Thanks all—looping in Zephyrus AM now to schedule the call.
